title: Refugees Act, 2017
source_tier: Official Gazette scan (Swaziland Government Gazette Vol. LV No. 142, 22 December 2017) + LII (EswatiniLII; Laws.Africa Legislation Commons PDF)
site_status: IN INCOMING (laws-2026-11-21.csv row 80): add Gazette details and commencement
note: Checked on 2026-11-21 against the Gazette scan and the Laws.Africa PDF supplied by IMR. Published in Swaziland Government Gazette No. 142 of 22 December 2017, Part B; assent date left blank in the Gazette, so 'adopted' is the Gazette date. s. 1(2): in force on a date set by the Minister by Gazette notice; Laws.Africa gives 1 November 2018. Gives effect to the 1951 Convention, 1967 Protocol and 1969 OAU Convention; s. 13(2) gives refugees the rights in arts. 2-34 of the 1951 Convention (incl. art. 17 wage-earning employment, art. 24 labour legislation and social security); s. 11 non-refoulement. s. 25 repeals the Refugees Control Order No. 5 of 1978.
